topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
response: MPLS VPNs offer deterministic path routing and QoS prioritization based on LSPs, ensuring predictable latency and bandwidth allocation for real-time applications. IPsec VPNs provide end-to-end security and prioritize traffic based on DSCP, achieving QoS but with less granular control. MPLS VPNs are suitable for mission-critical applications with strict latency requirements, while IPsec VPNs are better for security-focused applications.
